summary: Frontend-only verification of the new warm-cache admin panel + blur-up / no-broken-image regressions. Admin login at /admin with password 'xaluca' works; left sidebar renders (URLS/TEXTOS/GALERIAS/LIBRARY/LEADS/NOTIFICACIONES/MIRROR DB). Clicking MIRROR DB ([data-testid=admin-tab-mirror]) shows the Mirror DB section and below it the new 'Optimizar todas las imágenes' panel ([data-testid=warm-cache-panel]) with the start button ([data-testid=warm-cache-start-btn]) and a progress block ([data-testid=warm-cache-progress]). Backend warm-up confirmed running (curl-equivalent fetch from inside the admin page): total=4090, done growing 1076→1105→1182 across consecutive samples, errors=1 (acceptable), percent climbing 26.3→27→28.9. Trip regression PASSED on /viajes/atlas_desierto/programa_4n_5d: 5 day-gallery viewers, 238 , 158 loaded / 80 still lazy-pending below fold, 0 broken (no naturalWidth===0 with src set); blur-up image observed with class 'img-blurup' + is-loaded=true and full-quality w=1024&fmt=auto. ONE REAL FRONTEND BUG FOUND in the warm-cache panel: when the server is already running a warm-up at the time the admin opens the MIRROR DB tab, the panel mounts with status.running=true → start button is correctly disabled, BUT the polling setInterval is never started (it is created ONLY inside startWarm() which the disabled button blocks). Result: the progress text is frozen on the very first /status snapshot and never updates while the warm-up continues server-side. Verified by request listener: 0 GETs to /api/admin/warm-image-cache/status after mount (only the 2 initial useEffect calls), progress text stayed at exact same numbers for 18s while backend done counter advanced ~120+ images.

ui_bugs.issue: Progress UI does not auto-poll when a warm-up is already running at mount. setInterval(fetchStatus, 1500) is created only inside startWarm(); the start button is disabled while running, so the polling never starts and the progress block freezes on the initial /status snapshot indefinitely. Reproduces 100% by opening /admin → MIRROR DB while the server warm-up (auto-started at backend boot) is in progress.

critical_code_review_comments: WarmCachePanel: polling lifecycle is tied to the click handler only. Should be tied to status.running so the panel keeps polling regardless of who started the warm-up (boot vs. button).

fetchStatus swallows errors silently ('/* transient — keep polling */'). Acceptable for resilience, but when pollRef is never started (current bug) the user has no signal that progress is stale. After the fix, no change needed.
tokenHeader() reads localStorage on every call — fine but if token expires mid-poll the panel will silently keep getting 401s. Low priority; current bug is the blocker.
Trip page blur-up pipeline still healthy: 1 sample observed class='img-blurup' + is-loaded=true with full w=1024&fmt=auto src; 0 broken images across 238 on the 4n/5d itinerary.
Server warm-up is actively producing variants (generated counter climbed 4636 → 5302 in ~20s during the test). Backend side is fine; the issue is purely the frontend polling gating.

context_for_next_testing_agent: To reproduce the polling-freeze bug: (1) ensure the server has just started (warm-up auto-runs and takes minutes for 4000+ images) OR start one via curl; (2) open /admin, log in with 'xaluca', click MIRROR DB sidebar tab, scroll to the Optimizar todas las imágenes panel; (3) note that the start button shows 'OPTIMIZANDO…' and is disabled, the progress text shows e.g. '1182/4090 imágenes · 28.9%' and STAYS frozen for >15s while /api/admin/warm-image-cache/status (called manually from devtools) reports a higher 'done'. After the fix, opening the panel during an in-progress warm-up should tick the progress bar every 1.5s without any user interaction. Selectors: [data-testid=admin-tab-mirror], [data-testid=warm-cache-panel], [data-testid=warm-cache-start-btn], [data-testid=warm-cache-progress], [data-testid=warm-cache-done] (only when finished), [data-testid=warm-cache-error]. Note: navigate with wait_until='domcontentloaded' (networkidle never settles due to ongoing warm-up + Chatbase widget). The trip page blur-up + zero-broken-image regression is fine and does not need re-verification.
rca of the issue: AdminPage.jsx WarmCachePanel — pollRef lifecycle is owned by startWarm() only. On mount, useEffect calls fetchStatus() once (good) but does NOT start the polling interval. If the fetched status has running=true (warm-up started at backend boot), the start button is disabled by `disabled={running}` so the user cannot trigger startWarm() either, and the only place the interval is set is unreachable. Net effect: progress UI is a static snapshot. Mitigation: bind the interval to status.running via a dedicated useEffect (see action_items snippet).
